supportHymns.title: Poupou Fakafiemalie: Laipeli Himi
supportHymns.description: Puleʻi ʻa e ngaahi kataloko himi fakalea ʻoku fakaʻaongaʻi ʻe he polokalama fakatahá ʻoku fakakakato ʻotomētiki. ʻE fili ʻe he uooti takitaha ʻene lea fakafonua ʻoku ʻosi fakaʻaongaʻí.

supportConsole.title: Poupou ki he Fakafiemalie
supportConsole.description: Pule fakalotofonua ki he kau ngaue tokoni. Faka'aonga'i 'a e ngaahi konga 'i lalo ke pule'i 'a e kau faka'aonga'i, provisioning, mo e ngaahi kole 'o e intake.

queue.title: Laine Ngāue Poupou
queue.description: Kole, vahe, mo muimuiʻi ʻa e ngāue poupou fakamāmani lahí ʻo ʻikai foaki ha hū ki he uōtí.

users.title: Pule'i 'o e tokotaha ngaue
users.description: Toe vakaiʻi ʻa e ʻakauni kotoa pē ʻi he sisitemí, fakapapauʻi ʻa e ʻufiʻufi ʻo e fatongiá, pea fakaʻaongaʻi pe fakaʻauha ʻa e hū ʻi he taimi ʻoku fie maʻu ai ha tokoni poupou.

provisioning.title: Tokonaki ʻa e Siteikí & Uōtí
provisioning.description: Faʻu ha ngaahi siteiki mo ha ngaahi uooti foʻou, pea fakamoʻoniʻi leva ʻa e ngaahi lekooti tokonaki lolotongá kimuʻa pea toki vahe ʻa e kau pule ʻo e uōtí.

accessRequests.title: Ngaahi Kole ki he Hu
accessRequests.description: Toe vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi kole hū mai ʻoku hū mai mei he kau takí mo e kau kalaké koeʻuhí ke lava ʻo tokonaki ʻa e kau fakaʻaongaʻi kuo fakangofuá ʻi he uooti totonú.

auditLog.title: Tohi ʻAtita
auditLog.description: Toe vakai'i 'a e ngaahi ngaue kotoa pe 'a e sisitemi kau ai 'a e ngaahi lavame'a mo e ngaahi ta'elavame'a. Fakaʻilongaʻi mo fakahokohoko ʻa e ngaahi hūʻangá ʻo fakatatau ki he ngāué, tokotaha fakaʻaongaʻí, uōtí, pe ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho.

hymns.title: Laipeli Himi .
hymns.description: Puleʻi ʻa e lisi ʻo e ngaahi himi fakamāmani lahí ʻoku fakaʻaongaʻi ʻi he autocomplete ʻo e polokalama fakatahá. Tānaki, fakatonutonu, pe taʻofi ha ngaahi himi mei he tohi himi angamahení, tohi himi foʻoú, mo e tohi hiva ʻa e fānaú.
